title: The Cloud, the Pure Soul, the Three Births
description: What states bear influx, what soul stands free, and what modes the natural takes. T85 — the three states of perception that bear influx (rising from love, from natural truth, from thought), with the self's claim stripped from each: bearings up to the air of the midst over against the divine purity, the falling rain or hail or wind, and the fourth state from the conjoined air. T86 — the pure soul as a second ploughed field set within the entire Zone of the upper place, tilled from above by the two great Luminaries, drawn upward by likeness. T87 — the three modes by which the natural is brought forth (by conjunction, by failed productions, by self-molding alone), and the two paths to holiness: the virgin (untouched) and the continent (claimed-and-returned).
